description:
We are two university students majoring in Computer Science and Information Management, fueled by curiosity and questionable sleep schedules.

One of us once dreamed of getting lost on campus and missing a midterm exam. If navigating Earth is this hard, imagine Mars!

We're building an offline navigation system for Martian explorers. And the Martians? Surely they have places to be, too!

No Wi-Fi, no GPS, just curiosity.
